title: Amentoflavone mitigates UVB-induced epidermal photoaging by antagonizing PAR2-driven PI3K/Akt/FoxO6 oxidative-stress signaling.
authors: Li, Lin; Li, Zhiwei; Xiao, Shan; Li, Ang; Tian, Fang; Shu, Peng; Gu, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Amentoflavone通过PAR2信号通路缓解UVB诱导的皮肤光老化，属于纯湿实验与信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Escalating surface ultraviolet-B (UVB) radiation accelerates skin photoaging and underscores the need for safe, plant-derived photoprotectants. Amentoflavone (AF), the principal biflavonoid of the resurrection plant Selaginella tamariscina, has recognized anti-photoaging activity, yet its epidermal mechanism remains undefined. This study utilized animal and cellular models to investigate the therapeutic potential of AF (0.1-0.2 mg g(-1)) against photoaging. AF restored skin hydration and elasticity, reduced melanin deposition, and reversed UVB-induced epidermal hyperplasia and collagen/elastic-fiber disorganisation. AF decreased ROS and MDA while normalizing SOD, CAT and GSH-Px activities. Docking (LibDockScore = 125.596) and microscale thermophoresis (MST) revealed high-affinity AF-PAR2 interaction. Treatment with AF reduced PAR2 and Galphaq levels, curtailed activation of PI3K, phosphorylated Akt, and phosphorylated FoxO6, and restored FoxO6 nuclear localization, which in turn enhanced MnSOD and CAT expression. In addition, AF suppressed UVB-induced upregulation of senescence-associated markers p16, p21, and GLB1 in both rat skin and HaCaT cells. However, administration of the PAR2 agonist SLIGRL-NH(2) negated these benefits in both cellular and animal models. These findings position AF as a promising natural agent for anti-photoaging dermotherapy and provide a mechanistic basis for S. tamariscina-based product development.
abstract_zh: 不断升级的地表紫外线B（UVB）辐射加速了皮肤光老化，凸显了对安全、植物来源的光保护剂的需求。穗花杉双黄酮（Amentoflavone, AF）是复苏植物卷柏（Selaginella tamariscina）的主要双黄酮类化合物，具有公认的抗光老化活性，但其表皮机制尚不明确。本研究利用动物和细胞模型探讨了AF（0.1-0.2 mg g(-1)）对抗光老化的治疗潜力。AF恢复了皮肤水合作用和弹性，减少了黑色素沉积，并逆转了UVB诱导的表皮增生及胶原/弹性纤维紊乱。AF降低了ROS和MDA水平，同时使SOD、CAT和GSH-Px活性正常化。对接（LibDockScore = 125.596）和微量热泳动（microscale thermophoresis, MST）揭示了AF与PAR2的高亲和力相互作用。AF处理降低了PAR2和Galphaq水平，抑制了PI3K、磷酸化Akt和磷酸化FoxO6的激活，并恢复了FoxO6的核定位，进而增强了MnSOD和CAT的表达。此外，AF抑制了UVB诱导的大鼠皮肤和HaCaT细胞中衰老相关标志物p16、p21和GLB1的上调。然而，给予PAR2激动剂SLIGRL-NH(2)在细胞和动物模型中均抵消了这些益处。这些发现将AF定位为一种有前景的抗光老化皮肤治疗天然制剂，并为基于卷柏的产品开发提供了机制基础。
